title: Eight-agent resumable workflow with guarded RTX 4080, host and SSD capacity
basis: Measured 210552-token snapshots reached 3438997384 bytes, about 16333 bytes/token. Applying a 20% safety factor estimates 2.393 GiB for a 131072-token role. The 2026-11-10 live probe found 11.0 GiB free on RTX 4080, 30.4 GiB host RAM free and 1795.5 GiB free on E:. The capacity planner reports two helper-VRAM, five host-hot and 23 SSD target-sized snapshots. Live cutover retained ASR PID 8808 and TTS PID 16296, exposed 12288 MiB host cache, kept FastMCP 6/6, returned the OK canary, then saved a 248816800-byte project-prefixed architect snapshot and restored it on the next run.
changes: increase helper K/V cap from 4096 to 6144 MiB while retaining a 4096 MiB planner reserve
increase host conversation cache from 8192 to 12288 MiB
increase per-project SSD budget from 32 to 64 GiB and free-space floor from 4 to 32 GiB
add eight isolated roles, quality gates, two bounded revision cycles and per-stage run checkpoints
bound the active matrix at 250000 rows and preselect 4096 candidates before dense scoring
acceptance: capacity plan remains viable with ASR and TTS resident
all unit and restart-resume tests pass
24-hour eight-role coding trace loses zero canonical invariant
quality gates never mark UNKNOWN, REVISE or BLOCKED as successful
RTX 4080 retains at least 4096 MiB free after helper allocation
SSD use stays below 64 GiB and filesystem free space stays above 32 GiB
rollback: Restore STRATA_PARK_VRAM_MIB=4096, --conversation-cache-mib 8192 and configs/long-session-4080.json from the previous revision. Existing 64 GiB stores remain readable because the on-disk ledger, matrix, transcripts and snapshots are backward compatible.
limitations: The engine still exposes one active 524288-token slot. Eight specialists are sequential durable contexts, not eight simultaneous model replicas. MCP repository tools remain read-only, so model-generated edits require an external approved writer. Full 24-hour endurance and physical 64 GiB quota pressure are pending.
